description: Get a working Mockup Studio deep link for a product or a preset pack, so the user can upload their logo, position it in the real print zone and download a free mockup — no sign-in needed. A pack opens as one artboard per designable item in it. Use when someone asks how their logo would look on an item. Items that have no print zones yet return selfServeMockup: false and the product page instead of a link that would open empty — say the team will send a proof rather than promising a self-serve mockup.

slug.description: Product or preset-pack permalink slug or id (from search-products)

name: get-product-mockup
